prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.go in package solution.
Required API: func SuffixTroughs(input string) (string, bool)
Behavior: Parse a non-empty comma-separated list of canonical signed integers in -1000..1000. Return the minimum from each position through the end, joined by commas. Reject every malformed input by returning the language-specific absence value.
Visible example: 3,1,4,2 returns 1,1,2,2.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
